Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a Battle‐shocked unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
rule.flavor: With vox-augmented screams or bedecked in grisly trophies, these nightmarish raiders possess a terrifying presence. Even the most stoic of opponents can be shaken by their sadistic cruelty. Once fear has its hooks into them, they become easier prey.
rule.name: Terror Made Manifest

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Pairing unholy power with blistering speed, the full horror of these warriors’ strength is brought crashing into their foes.
stratagems.name: Malicious Surge
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.flavor: Accompanied by a burst of sensory torment, a sudden deployment can shatter the prey’s discipline.
stratagems.name: Horrific Incursion
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: These warriors strike in screaming waves, each charge as brutal as the last.
stratagems.name: Relentless Terror
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: When indecision and terror grip the foe, their frailties are exposed to the cruelest of lunges.
stratagems.name: Talons Sunk Deep
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Suitably wounded, or with the corpses of their comrades around them, the enemy’s faltering cohesion marks them as doomed.
stratagems.name: Prey on the Weak
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.flavor: It is not enough to slay. The foe’s allies must understand exactly what horrors await them.
stratagems.name: Sadistic Display
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES TZEENTCH model only. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, if the result of that test was 8 or more, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: No secret is safe from Tzeentch’s searching gaze. To those who bear his favour, priceless knowledge may be revealed.
enhancements.name: Eye of Tzeentch

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES SLAANESH model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Each time the bearer shoots or fights, if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact this phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test, after the bearer has resolved those attacks, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.flavor: This concoction fortifies the imbiber and causes them to emit a stultifying perfume that enthrals the foe.
enhancements.name: Intoxicating Elixir

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES NURGLE model only. At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within 3" of the bearer, adding 1 to the result if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact that phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test: on a 4+, that enemy  unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
enhancements.flavor: Nurgle's malignance fortifies his chosen and bestows upon them the gift of terrible contagion.
enhancements.name: Orbs of Unlife

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES KHORNE model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, roll one D3: until the end of the phase, add the result to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.
enhancements.flavor: This crimson gem radiates malice, granting its bearer but a sliver of Khorne’s boundless fury.
enhancements.name: Talisman of Burning Blood

rule.body:
When mustering your army, when you select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit to include in your army, if that unit is not an EPIC HERO and does not already have one of the following keywords, you must select one for that unit and note it on your Army Roster: KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE, SLAANESH, CHAOS UNDIVIDED. Each time a unit with one of these keywords gains a weapon ability as the result of a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, until the end of the phase, that unit gains the associated ability below.

UNITS THAT GAINED [LETHAL HITS]
▪ KHORNE: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
▪ TZEENTCH: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
▪ CHAOS UNDIVIDED: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit  roll of 1.

UNITS THAT GAINED [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
▪ NURGLE: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
▪ SLAANESH: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
▪ CHAOS UNDIVIDED: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
rule.name: Marks of Chaos

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Those Heretic Astartes sworn to the service of the Dark Gods display zeal through violence.
stratagems.name: Profane Zeal
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that CHARACTER model, and add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of that CHARACTER model’s melee weapons.
stratagems.flavor: The eyes of the Dark Gods fall upon those who slaughter in their name.
stratagems.name: Eye of the Gods
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER model in that unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED, DAEMON and EPIC HERO units) destroys an enemy unit.

stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, if your unit is a Tzeentch unit below its Starting Strength, one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: Those who offer praise to the God of Change may gam the benefits of his mutagenic powers.
stratagems.name: Skinshift
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a Slaanesh unit, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: As these warriors traverse the battlefield, an unnatural symphony of hypnotic music accompanies their every move, stupefying their enemies.
stratagems.name: Torpefying Refrain
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it is a Khorne unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: The Blood God’s thirst can never be slaked.
stratagems.name: Eternal Hate
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. In addition, if your unit is a Nurgle unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.flavor: A roiling storm of warp energy obscures the Heretic Astartes, leaving their foes shooting at indistinct shadows.
stratagems.name: Festering Miasma
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent’s deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1 CP.
enhancements.flavor: This champion is a conqueror of worlds and will not rest until they have claimed their prize.
enhancements.name: Despot’s Claim

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: A corsair and raider of great renown, this champion of Chaos is pitiless in the pursuit of plunder and infamy.
enhancements.name: Dread Reaver

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.
enhancements.flavor: This unit of warriors act as their master's eyes and ears, seeking out targets of opportunity.
enhancements.name: Mark of the Hound

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. You can re-roll Advance rolls made for the bearer’s unit, and the bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
enhancements.flavor: Pain provides excellent motivation. The crack of this infernal whip sears the soul, driving the hesitant forwards with a vigour borne of anguish.
enhancements.name: Tyrant’s Lash

rule.body: Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
rule.flavor: Some Heretic Astartes warbands are piratical by nature, launching swift attacks focused upon destroying their foes in a storm of bloody violence, seizing territory and spoils of war before the enemy can bring reinforcements to bear.
rule.name: Raiders and Reavers

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.flavor: If the bounty is to be claimed, the foe must first be purged.
stratagems.name: Scour and Seize
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Such is their determination to claim their due that these warriors will gladly weather a storm of fire.
stratagems.name: Unfailingly Obdurate
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a  model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Utilising their swift transports, these ravagers plunge through the enemy lines to assault key positions.
stratagems.name: Ruinous Raid
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase

stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
stratagems.flavor: Mobility is the key to victory These Heretic Astartes raiders outmanoeuvre and outflank the foe in order to achieve victory.
stratagems.name: Opportunistic Raiders
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it  Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
stratagems.flavor: The prospect of riches spurs these renegade warriors forwards. Woe betide any in their path.
stratagems.name: Reaver’s Haste
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit  Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: The engines of this vehicle or construct crackle with the raw energies of the immaterium, propelling it forward or incredible speed.
stratagems.name: Warpcharged Engines
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. That enemy unit becomes your Vendetta target until you select a new one.
enhancements.flavor: This champion’s bitterness has been tempered like a blade, and is wielded with the brutal efficacy to match.
enhancements.name: Weaponised Hatred

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Immersion within the mutagenic energies of the Warp has wrought changes upon this warrior’s eyes. Slit pupils and warp sight enable them to pick out their targets with unerring accuracy.
enhancements.name: Eyes of the Hunter

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In a turn in which the bearer’s unit chose to Default to Doctrine, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: The trophy racks of this warrior’s Terminator armour bear the skulls of former battle-brothers slain by his own hand. The warriors that fight at his side strive their hardest to avoid sharing the fate of their former comrades.
enhancements.name: Fratricidal Trophies

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.
enhancements.flavor: This champion of ruin has been bonded with a warp-spawned symbiote. This malefic companion’s predatory senses sense the quickest route to the enemy.
enhancements.name: Empyric Symbiote

rule.body:
### Slaves to None
HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability.

Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.

### Vendetta
At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

### Twisted Doctrine
In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Battle-shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle-shock test. Then, select one of the following:
▪ Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
▪ Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
rule.flavor: Many Renegades eschew the gifts of Dark Gods, relying only upon their own prowess.
rule.name: Slaves to None & Vendetta & Twisted Doctrine

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.
stratagems.name: Vengeful Destruction
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding Damned units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.
stratagems.name: Corrupted Munitions
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.flavor: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.
stratagems.name: Never Outgunned
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.flavor: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.
stratagems.name: Reavers’ Reaction
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.
stratagems.name: Renegade Claim
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.
stratagems.name: Undying Hatred
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
enhancements.flavor: Such is this warriors mastery of techno-sorcery, that they may temper armour with but a gesture.
enhancements.name: Forge’s Blessing

enhancements.body: WARPSMITH model only. Add 4" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.
enhancements.flavor: Suffused with warp power, the bearer’s mechatendrils undulate with unsettling celerity, propelling them forwards with unnatural speed.
enhancements.name: Invigorated Mechatendrils

enhancements.body:
HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army invokes its contract while within 3" of the bearer:
▪ If it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result  of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers.
▪ Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: The Arkifane’s contracts are malleable by design. More power can be offered should the supplicant be willing to bear the debt in souls.
enhancements.name: Tempting Addendum

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: To stoke the fires of a daemon forge requires a bounty of souls. Thus do the Warpsmiths and their allies undertake a never-ending harvest.
enhancements.name: Soul Harvester

rule.body:
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact, and until the end of the phase:
▪ Each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
▪ Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.
rule.flavor: Many are the daemons who have forged pacts with Vashtorr the Arkifane. Once bound into such a contract, a soul debt must be paid, one that the daemon strives endlessly, and with all its desperation, to fulfil.
rule.name: Debt to the Soul Forge

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: A daemon construct may beseech the Arkifane for further aid, adding to its soul debt in return for greater might.
stratagems.name: Desperate Pledge
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
stratagems.flavor: Those steeped in techno-sorcery may trammel daemonic entities within mechanical constructs.
stratagems.name: Daemonic Possession
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Daemon units).
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
stratagems.flavor: The tortured machine spirits of Heretic Astartes vehicles are driven forward by their anguish.
stratagems.name: Unstoppable Rampage
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wounds).
stratagems.flavor: Wrh each soul harvested the bound daemon comes closer to settling its contract and earning freedom.
stratagems.name: Glut of Souls
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.flavor: Corrupted Heretic Astartes Vehicles Pursue their prey with an animalistic determination.
stratagems.name: Predatory Pursuit
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
stratagems.flavor: The daemonic entities at the heart of possessed vehicles hunger for the life force of their enemies.
stratagems.name: Feeding Frenzy
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer’s unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit’s charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
enhancements.flavor: The desire for vengeance and bloodshed has festered within this warriors’ heart for millennia. The opportunity to unleash it upon the foe is eagerly embraced.
enhancements.name: Eager for Vengeance

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: The Warmaster observes all. He bestows his favour only upon those who slaughter his most hated enemies.
enhancements.name: Eye of Abaddon

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has earned the patronage of a powerful daemonic entity and been rewarded with unholy powers.
enhancements.name: Mark of Legend

enhancements.body: CHAOS LORD model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior bears a daemonic weapon of great power, gifted unto to them by the Despoiler himself.
enhancements.name: Warmaster’s Gift

rule.body: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
rule.flavor: The eldest of the Chaos Space Marines harbour within their corrupted souls a burning desire for vengeance upon the Imperium and the galaxy as a whole.  They channel this ire against their chosen targets, relentlessly pursuing their victims until every last foe lies dead upon the battlefield.
rule.name: Focus of Hatred

stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.
stratagems.name: Contemptuous Disregard
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
stratagems.flavor: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.
stratagems.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.flavor: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.
stratagems.name: Bringers of Despair
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
stratagems.flavor: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.
stratagems.name: Endless Ire
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from  your army (excluding DAMNED units)
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.
stratagems.name: Millennia of Experience
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is  eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced  or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have  the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
stratagems.flavor: The Warmaster s Black Crusade grinds ever onwards without restraint or remorse.
stratagems.name: Black Crusade
stratagems.sublabel: Veterans of the Long War – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army  (excluding DAMNED units).
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding Damned models). Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.
enhancements.flavor: This strange artefact was recovered from the storm-lashed daemon world of Utrexismia. A shard of warp lightning frozen forever in reality, it serves as a potent focus for teleportation.
enhancements.name: Infernal Fulgurite

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.
enhancements.flavor: This burning gem allows its bearer to see through the veil between realspace and the Warp, and so to react instantly upon piercing that veil.
enhancements.name: Eye of the Warp

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.
enhancements.flavor: Living runes that crawl from an ancient tome onto living skin, these sigils anchor their host to realspace even when they are immersed in the Empyrean.
enhancements.name: Akshur’s Binding Runes

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the turn, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1.
enhancements.flavor: This shape-shifting daemon weapon feeds upon the presence of warp energy to empower both itself and its wielder.
enhancements.name: Tzagulla

rule.body:
At the end of your opponent’s turn, you can select a number of HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, Obliterators and Mutilators units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
▪ **Incursion:** Up to 1 unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** Up to 2 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** Up to 3 units.

Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
rule.flavor: Conjured warp portals flicker across the battlefield, tearing through the fabric of reality according to arcane designs. They are a means, however perilous and unnatural, for the warband’s most elite warriors to traverse the battlefield in a matter of strides and strike again at new locations.
rule.name: Warp Portals

stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: These warriors have not quite escaped the grip of the Warp, remaining slightly incorporeal in a way that causes enemy fire to pass harmlessly through them.
stratagems.name: Empyric Dislocation
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.
stratagems.flavor: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.
stratagems.name: Portal of Spite
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: Drawn to the largest and toughest warriors by their inherent sense of might and superiority, overspilling warp energies make their conceit a resilient reality.
stratagems.name: Armour of Corruption
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: Immaterial energies still cling to these warriors like tattered shrouds, leaving sites of significance tainted by their touch and haunted by insubstantial spectres.
stratagems.name: Warp-Tainted
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.flavor: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.
stratagems.name: Siegebreaker Strike
stratagems.target: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Momentary flares of empyric energy wreathe this unit, causing them to stutter through time and space more swiftly.
stratagems.name: Warp Flicker
stratagems.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

enhancements.body:
HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding KHORNE models).
▪ This model has PSYKER.
▪ This model’s weapons have [PSYCHIC].
enhancements.flavor: Saturated with empyric energies, this dark champion has spontaneously manifested the mutant powers of a true psyker.
enhancements.name: Touched by the Warp

enhancements.body: HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON model only (excluding KHORNE models). This model’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
enhancements.flavor: Like a lightning rod, this blessed fiend attracts the arcane energies of the Warp, unleashing them in a crackling storm of mutating horror as it plunges into the foe.
enhancements.name: Conduit of Chaos

rule.body:
▪ In your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (excluding DAEMON units) is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, if that unit makes a **[gloss:csm-dark-pact:Dark Pact]**, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 S.
▪ In the Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS unit (excluding KHORNE units) is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, if that unit makes a **Dark Pact**, that unit’s melee attacks have:
▪ +2 S.
▪ +1 AP.
rule.flavor: The sorcerous powers wielded by a cabal inevitably draw the attention of the Dark Gods, flooding the battlefield with immaterial energies that empower their dark magicks and their daemonically gifted comrades alike.
rule.name: Empyric Wellspring

stratagems.effect: Your unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** D3+1 wounds.
stratagems.flavor: With the unbound energies of the Warp surging through them, this infernal champion heals of their hurts as quickly as the enemy can inflict them.
stratagems.name: Infernal Vigour
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:
▪ On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
▪ On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
▪ On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.
These mortal wounds are inflicted by a Psychic Attack.
stratagems.flavor: Chanting words of forbidden power, this heretic witch triggers a ghastly explosion of hypermutation within the bodies of foes, rapidly transforming them into heaving mounds of gibbering meat.
stratagems.name: Fleshy Curse
stratagems.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
stratagems.flavor: Secondary cantrips blossom out like poisoned flowers from the heart of this sorcerous manifestation, raining mutating flame upon the foe in roiling clouds.
stratagems.name: Wreathed in Warpflame
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

enhancements.body:
WARPSMITH model only.
▪ When this unit uses its **[gloss:csm-dark-pact:Dark Pacts]** ability, this unit can re-roll Leadership rolls.
▪ In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its **Dark Pacts** ability and if those attacks **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy model, this unit **[gloss:heal:heals]** 3 wounds.
enhancements.flavor: There are those daemonic entities within the Warp that are willing to offer their boons to any who will wreak wholesale devastation in their name, at least for as long as the carnage holds their capricious attention.
enhancements.name: Pact of Destruction

enhancements.body: WARPSMITH model only. When this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until this unit has shot.
enhancements.flavor: This vile techno-daemonic parasite nests within the emptied eye socket of its host, driving filament tendrils deep into their brain and feeding on their animus in exchange for revealing the secrets of its supernatural vision.
enhancements.name: Eye of Oblivion

rule.body: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units’ ranged attacks have [HEAVY].
rule.flavor: It is not enough for these heretical reavers merely to defeat their foes. Instead, they must pound all before them to smouldering oblivion with overwhelming salvoes of fire.
rule.name: Rain of Ruin

stratagems.effect:
When your unit uses the **[gloss:csm-dark-pact:Dark Pacts]** ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have:
▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.flavor: As the murderous rain of projectiles redoubles and the fires of ruin burn higher, so the favour of the Dark Gods falls upon the architects of this devastation.
stratagems.name: Ruination's Bounty
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".
stratagems.flavor: Even as the foe attempts to escape the rain of ruination, or to close with the foes so cruelly winnowing their ranks, so these Havocs move to establish new sight lines and draw their victims into an inescapable crossfire.
stratagems.name: Snare of Fire
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.

stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to Wound rolls.
stratagems.flavor: Gripped by a maniacal need to annihilate their hated enemies, these killers will not easily succumb to the clutches of death.
stratagems.name: Undying Hatred
stratagems.target: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

enhancements.body: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only. This unit has 5+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.
enhancements.flavor: Worked with diabolical incantations of occlusion, wound about with subtle enchantments, this onyx disc draws a penumbral aura about the bearer that hides him from the eyes of his prey.
enhancements.name: Shadowcowl Talisman

enhancements.body:
CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only.
▪ This model has DAEMON.
▪ This model’s melee attacks have +1 A.
enhancements.flavor: Sharing their mortal frame with a predatory possessor daemon lends this dark champion additional might and swiftness, though it may yet damn them for eternity.
enhancements.name: Pact of Cursed Pinions

rule.body:
▪ Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units’ attacks that target a Battle-shocked unit or a unit at or below half-strength can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
▪ When an enemy unit’s attacks target a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked or at or below half-strength, those attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

This **[gloss:detachments:detachment]** has the **NIGHTMARE** tag and cannot be taken with another **NIGHTMARE** **detachment**.
rule.flavor: The more bloodied, scattered and thinned are the ranks of the enemy, the more frenzied and brutal the attacks of these sadistic Chaos Space Marines become.
rule.name: Prey on the Weak

stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
stratagems.flavor: With a last-second blast of speed from their jump packs, the Chaos Space Marines slam into their enemies blades-first.
stratagems.name: Plunging Talons
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]** this turn is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.flavor: Surging in and out of the enemy lines on wings of dark fire, these predatory killers wreak bloody havoc.
stratagems.name: Raking Pass
stratagems.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.
stratagems.flavor: So hideous and otherworldly have many Warp Talons been rendered by the energies of the Warp, that merely to look upon their approach is enough to scare the enemy out of their minds.
stratagems.name: Warp-twisted Terrors
stratagems.target: That WARP TALONS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.
